lines.text: Many learners say: Yes, I don't like fish.
Better: No, I don't like fish.

quiz.stem: You don't like fish? ___, I don't.

native.hook: 否定疑問への Yes/No、逆では？
native.tip: 「魚が嫌い？」に「はい、嫌い」は Yes ではなく No。事実で答えよう。
native.caption: “Yes, I don't like fish.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語は相手の言葉に同意するかで「はい」と答えますが、英語は答えの内容が否定なら No です。 “No, I don't like fish.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“No”。否定の答えは No。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Yes or No? Japanese habit trap!
en.tip: In English, answer by the fact. If it is negative, say No.
en.caption: Do you say “Yes, I don't like fish.”? 😅 Japanese says hai to agree with the question. English says No if your answer is negative. The natural way is “No, I don't like fish.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
